claims.statement: Purple has partnered with mattress and furniture retailers to bring its comfort products to customers.
claims.quote: Purple has partnered with mattress and furniture retailers to achieve its mission of bringing its comfort products to customers however, whenever and wherever they want them.

claims.statement: Purple celebrates Grid Day to recognize its loyal customers and give them a platform to share how Purple has changed their lives.
claims.quote: Grid Day turns that passion into an occasion, serving as a dedicated day to celebrate existing owners, giving them a platform to share how Purple has changed their lives for the better

claims.statement: Purple partnered with Raymour & Flanigan to offer customers in the Northeast a high-touch experience.
claims.quote: This partnership will help us offer customers in the Northeast a high-touch experience when shopping for a Purple mattress

claims.statement: Purple has an annual campaign called Grid It Forward, which aims to gift and discount mattresses to loyal customers.
claims.quote: We are thrilled to celebrate Grid Day by gifting and discounting hundreds of our next-generation mattresses to our most loyal customers and the people in their corners who deserve a better night's rest

email_subject: An Instagram carousel idea for Grid It Forward
email_body:
Dear Purple Marketing Team,

We propose a collaborative Instagram carousel built around your Grid It Forward holiday campaign {C5}. Each slide would share a loyal customer's story, in the spirit of Grid Day, which you established to recognize your loyal customers {C2}. Our team would handle the design and invite customers to take part.

If this sounds interesting, we'd be happy to share a draft.

Best regards,
[Your Team]
